nodes.label: graphify
nodes.rationale: Adopted so codebase questions are answered from a scoped knowledge-graph query (graphify query/path/explain) instead of raw grep or full GRAPH_REPORT.md reads, reducing context cost while keeping cross-file relationships discoverable.

nodes.label: context-mode
nodes.rationale: Adopted to keep large tool/command/web output out of the conversation context by routing it through a sandboxed execute/search/index layer, only surfacing derived results, and to preserve searchable session memory across /compact, /clear, and --resume.
